non_evidence_disclaimer: Solver feasibility and approximate roots were inspected before this file was written. This is not a preregistration and contains no Phase39 scientific result.
purpose: Run the smallest nontrivial full-joint algorithm pilot before higher finite cutoffs: solve one genuine discrete saddle, transport its full upward-cycle tangent, and evaluate the six-real-dimensional local oriented intersection determinant against one independently anchored regulated-cycle candidate.

model.name: two-segment midpoint Starobinsky minisuperspace configuration regulator

fixed_boundary.source: Phase25 benchmark, inherited without tuning to the Phase39 intersection

model.analytic_domain: C^2 times C-star in T; T=0 is excluded as an action pole

saddle_protocol.seed_source: the inherited short connected continuum branch sampled at the interior midpoint, used only as a numerical seed

gradient_metric.whitening_definition: At the recomputed real saddle, diagonalize the real symmetric reference-coordinate Hessian H_w=O*Lambda*O^T with det(O)=+1 and set L=O*diag(abs(Lambda)^(-1/2)); use w=w_saddle+L*xi with the Euclidean Hermitian metric in xi.
gradient_metric.global_constancy: After the saddle is solved, L is held constant on every transported trajectory; it is not recomputed along the flow.
gradient_metric.selection_note: This conditioning metric was chosen after a feasibility pilot and is not claimed to be physically selected.

upward_cycle.local_frame: Takagi frame derived from the real symmetric Hessian in the frozen dimensionless coordinates, with deterministic eigenvector signs and orientation
upward_cycle.reported_root_chart: equatorial chart omega(alpha,beta)=(cos(beta)cos(alpha),cos(beta)sin(alpha),sin(beta)); its coordinate poles are excluded
upward_cycle.discovery_atlas: six normalized cubed-sphere faces cover S^2 for a bounded first-hit sample; face overlaps are a mutation control, not an exhaustion theorem

declared_original_cycle_candidate.status: finite-window Gaussian-lift candidate, not a derived physical original relative cycle
declared_original_cycle_candidate.oriented_lapse_path: [-R,-r] followed by N=r*exp(i*theta), theta from -pi to 0, followed by [r,R]
declared_original_cycle_candidate.field_anchor: constant interior history equal to the fixed endpoint; the target saddle is not used as the anchor
declared_original_cycle_candidate.negative_arm_embedding: For N in [-R,-r], hold the continuously unwrapped endpoint phases psi=-pi/2: a_1=a_boundary+exp(-3*pi*i/4)*y_a, phi_1=phi_boundary+exp(-pi*i/4)*y_phi, T=i*N.
declared_original_cycle_candidate.positive_arm_embedding: For N in [r,R], hold the continuously unwrapped endpoint phases psi=+pi/2: a_1=a_boundary+exp(-pi*i/4)*y_a, phi_1=phi_boundary+exp(+pi*i/4)*y_phi, T=i*N.
declared_original_cycle_candidate.provenance: finite full-joint lift of the Phase32 declared below-origin full-lapse bypass and principal configuration rays
declared_original_cycle_candidate.orientation_note: The Phase32 momentum-times-configuration +1 normalization is not inherited; Phase39 reports only the newly declared configuration-chain coordinate orientation.

intersection_protocol.root_jacobian_warning: the solver Jacobian [V_Gamma,-V_K] differs by (-1)^3 from the requested oriented-intersection determinant
intersection_protocol.bounded_census: record all detected first cap hits in a deterministic alpha scan of the beta=0 real-symmetry component and a deterministic multistart scan over the full sphere chart; this is not a proof of exhaustion

exact: single symbolic scalar produces the gradient and Hessian
action is holomorphic on T nonzero and explicitly meromorphic at T=0
flow identities give monotone Re(S) and constant Im(S)
Gamma and K frames have the declared middle dimension
orientation mutations flip only the local determinant sign
numerical: genuine discrete joint saddle residual and Hessian inertia
upward-flow Re(S) monotonicity and Im(S) conservation
isolated full-space root residual at both declared cap radii
bounded real-component and full-sphere discovery ledger

promotion_boundary: A successful run may support only a declared finite-cutoff local full-space intersection candidate. It cannot establish the physical original cycle, a complete upward cycle, a global PL coefficient, Gate 1 closure, a BFV/Pfaffian/Pin result, or quantum gravity.
